notes: Strength values are current, not maximum. A formation that dies is struck from this file and never returns.

formations.name: Oakhand
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: won a straight fight against Gatewright.

formations.name: Stonewatch
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: never engaged. The fight never reached her side of the line.

formations.name: Marrow
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: caught alongside Ferrant when Toll-taker broke both of them at once. Marrow got clear; Ferrant did not.

formations.name: Thistle
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: cut down the same Toll-taker that had broken Ferrant and Marrow, then beat Scrip in the same round. The two hardest fights of the battle, back to back.

formations.name: Coldbrook
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: reached the field and never took a wound.

formations.name: Harrow
history: Battle 1 — The Toll Road: two shots, two hits — chipped Whistle, then killed Coin outright.

fallen.name: Kestrel
fallen.detail: Lost a duel with Tally over the crossing.

fallen.name: Ferrant
fallen.detail: Fought three separate melees in one battle — beat Reeve, retreated once, beat Reeve again, beat Toll-taker, beat Tally — before Toll-taker's line finally brought her down in the fourth. No formation in the campaign has yet matched that.

fallen.name: Ash
fallen.detail: Lost the three-way scrum for the crossing to Coin.
